title: Inventory Health
description: Stock levels, movement and gaps — on-hand by warehouse, in vs out movement trend, items out of stock and the biggest holdings.
notes: Built from Item Master (OITM), Warehouse Stock (OITW), the Inventory Journal (OINM) and open Inventory Transfer Requests (OWTQ). Quantities are in each item's stock UoM; mixed-UoM totals are indicative. Stock value is the cumulative inventory journal value (cost), so it reflects all history regardless of the date filter.
